trailhead.label: Carella cemetery, via Ceresuola, Eupilio, the published start

cautions: A rougher woodland path between the sanctuary and via Cornizzolo.
Stretches on via Cornizzolo, the road to the Rifugio SEC, with cars at weekends.
Farm animals behind the fence at the Alpe di Carella: keep your dog close.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
